description: Returns one page in full by its object id — works for slides, layouts, masters and notes pages alike. For a slide the response includes slideProperties.notesPage (the speaker-notes page) and every pageElement with its size, transform (EMU: 1 pt = 12700 EMU) and complete text. Use it when list_slides' summary is not enough for one page but the whole deck via get_presentation would be too much.

page_object_id.description: The page's object id — a slide/layout/master/notes-page id from list_slides or get_presentation.

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

name: get_page
title: Get one page
